service_mode.quote: that the petitioner was not aware of the show cause notice issued by the respondent, as several notices were uploaded on the same web portal

events.quote: show cause notice in Form GST DRC-01 dated 26.11.2024
resulted in the petitioner failing to submit a reply to the show cause notice
impugned Assessment Order dated 09.04.2025 passed by the respondent

defects_argued.note: issuing notice under section 74 instead of 74A
defects_argued.quote: This Court is of the view that, admittedly, the respondent, without any authority of law, issued the show cause notice under Section 74 of the Act instead of under Section 74A of the Act and also passed the impugned Assessment Order.

outcome.quote: With the above observations and directions, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
